note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(饮食/餐桌主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: At the school food festival, Mia felt nervous about tasting dishes from other countries. A classmate told her that she needn't eat anything she really disliked, but that she ought to give each dish at least a small bite. By the end of the day, Mia had found three new favourite foods and was glad that she had been brave enough to try.

questions.q: What did the classmate advise Mia to do?
options: Take a small taste of every dish, even if she wasn't sure.
Avoid all the foreign dishes completely.
Eat only the dishes she already knew.
Leave the festival before tasting anything.
questions.explanation: 同学建议每道菜至少尝一小口,即"ought to give each dish at least a small bite"的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did Mia feel at the end of the day?
options: Sorry that she had come to the festival.
Pleased that she had dared to try new foods.
Bored because the food was all the same.
Angry that nobody helped her choose.
questions.explanation: 末句说她很高兴自己有勇气尝试,covers 短文后半段,转述而非照抄。
